notes: Real community-event source feeds for Crescent City / Del Norte County. Probe status recorded from live HTTP checks on 2026-08-26.

sources.name: City of Crescent City Events Calendar
sources.notes: Official city calendar (EvoGov platform). Lists meetings and community events with detail pages like /events/{id}/; date lines render as 'Mon D, YYYY at H:MM AM - ...'. RSS probe at /calendar/RSSFeed.aspx returns HTTP 403 (blocked), so this source is parsed as HTML. Extraction strategy: evogov-json - calendar ids are read from the listing page's calendar-selection checkboxes, then the site's public meetings/get_list JSON endpoint is queried for a 90-day window.

sources.name: County of Del Norte Community Events Calendar
sources.notes: County 'Community Events' calendar on the Del Norte county site; EvoGov-style list/month views. Extraction strategy: evogov-json - calendar ids are read from the listing page's calendar-selection checkboxes, then the site's public meetings/get_list JSON endpoint is queried for a 90-day window.

sources.name: Del Norte County Library District Programs & Events
sources.notes: Library district programs page; links to a Google Calendar of events and monthly branch PDF calendars. HTML listings parsed here.

sources.name: Visit Del Norte County (Chamber) Events
sources.notes: Crescent City/Del Norte Chamber of Commerce tourism site event series pages. Root /events/ redirects (HTTP 301) to a canonical path; redirect followed.
